# Key features of SpotDraft's Hubspot integration

Last updated 9 months ago

## Complete CLM Access Within Your CRM

### Seamless Contract Management Experience

SpotDraft's Hubspot integration provides your sales team with full access to all contract lifecycle management (CLM) features directly within your Hubspot environment. This integration enables your team to manage the entire contracting process seamlessly, eliminating the need to switch between platforms.

![hubspotmain.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/6778eb64-1393-4a30-936f-e9304ea5012e%2Fc5d01ae0-0eb7-48be-ba27-3cfb125ad5f2-28519620395037.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=LF~MDxhvwUlZpzGzHk82iRks2FPaaz4ZNRiti9sDh0xXewWQq5adv2xeGtPbScRed0VdT~F2andDpsQNF4QO2CDGbqjnowWAMmw34ZkQpBikkp6Ufq5VmxnZaw5MajuUABR03sbsuZDBObhF5aH9nYKgonJe9TkCYwtUpStFM-gef4gETCW-pZh32I9Y3M6D5r5TQFLn9F-xIkMk9Y5wnxazy9ChaBxZnR~vVWAXgK13Y4cFFKtd5VTtRChLbN7lM1kGJvVWRSgRaLaZPB3U~Qsh2U4Dkwu2V9z0ceJvC~AgiN952calp1ISIDlks8r1UnsaMtKD5Cnb3Ct~UkfO8A__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

### Key Features

- **Complete CLM Functionality**: Access SpotDraft's full feature set without leaving Hubspot

- **Real-Time Collaboration**: Work directly with legal teams on contract reviews and approvals




![hubspotAL.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/6778eb64-1393-4a30-936f-e9304ea5012e%2F10d03611-1c40-4198-850f-f3aadfcfee84-28519613280285.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=p13dbHftrmDb904yjf4oj5vsCPS-NA6SK6MaFY0yLZ2M5lFChcCGTecS06fw1XLtUYUMfBW0ZzYR3iI-XwUbxJpCjnwQrsGtpt9ulNVEsIX1VrEZVJcMpYR33kn9oOqZUFHwsyv3C0r4WfCZjV1IF~lsZoQhgi-XqRUBnJ5uTPBIm5ijB-q0auZQdeVhdr4FTiWZL9Mss2Qp~5tC6Sb8OCZJnS4qO1CoCTRxqiwZhD4EQpjE5ykFp7ixU4MUDkZ6rp20qQFWHGE1atLWLn5EZICkrqJsmZ3NzNoTRu5jqhZ-C9km2mMUPcymGdewb32qFJwcqkkR3qWsOfWo462r7g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
- **Contract Visibility**: View all contract metadata and current status at a glance

- **Streamlined Workflow**: Manage the entire contract process from creation to execution

- **Intuitive Interface**: User-friendly design with familiar visual elements (clouds and rolling hills shown in the screenshot)


### Benefits for Sales Teams

Unlike most CLM integrations that offer limited functionality, SpotDraft ensures your sales team can remain in their preferred Hubspot environment throughout the entire contracting process. This seamless experience increases productivity while maintaining full collaboration with legal stakeholders.

The integration is designed to enhance your existing Hubspot workflow rather than requiring teams to adapt to multiple systems.

## Transparent Data Mapping

### Intelligent Field Mapping with Visual Feedback

SpotDraft's Hubspot integration provides complete visibility into your contract data and instantly highlights potential issues. Our intelligent field mapping system automatically populates your contract questionnaires with existing Hubspot data, eliminating redundant data entry for your sales team.

### Key Features

#### Automated Data Population

- Contract fields are automatically filled with corresponding Hubspot data

- Sales teams save time by avoiding manual re-entry of information

- Clear visual indicators show which fields are mapped from Hubspot


#### Transparent Data Sourcing

- Hover-over tooltips clearly indicate which Hubspot fields are being used

- Visual indicators show exactly where the data is being pulled from

- Complete transparency into the data mapping process


#### Error Detection & Resolution

- Instant visual alerts for data mapping issues

- Clear error messages explain missing or incompatible values

- One-click option to manually override and correct problematic fields


### Benefits for Sales Teams

Our transparent approach to data mapping eliminates the "black box" confusion common in other integrations. Users always understand where their contract data originates, can quickly identify and resolve issues, and maintain complete confidence in data consistency between systems.

By providing clear visibility into the contract creation process, SpotDraft ensures your sales team can work efficiently while maintaining data accuracy throughout the contract lifecycle.
